svg.title: Designed variation SG-01
svg.desc: अकारान्त | Relation: तृतीया एकवचनम् | वैदिक: -आ and -एन; e.g. यज्ञा / यज्ञेन. Vedic verse can lengthen final -एन to -एना | in recitation, but that is a metrical realization of the -एन form rather than a | third declensional ending. | लौकिक: -एन; e.g. यज्ञेन | Contribution: MAT · ARR · RES · Evidence: passage checked · function shown | Prevalence: 11.1% (1/9 tokens) · grade B
